name: dsh-computer-history-editor
description: Tells the local DeepSeek Harness where work is happening: the workspace root and the active file, nothing else.

dshComputerHistory.port.description: Loopback port the Host listens on for companion observations.

dshComputerHistory.token.description: Pairing token. Shown once in the Host panel; without it nothing is sent.

dshComputerHistory.traceFile.description: Optional file path to append the companion's decisions to, for diagnosing why nothing was sent.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Reads the workspace root and the active file path only; it never reads file contents.
